name: aws-apm
description: Personal-prototype AWS APM investigation plugin for Claude Code and Cowork — SLO breach investigation, latency regression, error spike triage, CloudWatch alarm response, SLO compliance reporting, fleet health check, post-investigation self-validation, and persistent incident memory, with curated artifact components on top of AWS CloudWatch, Application Signals, and CloudTrail MCP servers. Not an official AWS or Anthropic product.
